terminal.completion: One parent-owned bounded child completion; no watch-pattern message bus.

cron.repeat_policy: Parent computes floor((expiry - current UTC epoch)/120); refuse if less than one. Script becomes inert at expiry even if scheduler is delayed.

activation_order: Independent review and parent approval; source PR is not activation.
Reconcile/stop the old foreground GitHub reader without overwriting its latest cursor; it does not honor these new locks.
Parent stages reviewed regular source bytes under HERMES_HOME/scripts; no symlink outside allowed root.
Check authenticated gh, running native scheduler, absent duplicate job/listener and fresh preserved cursor.
Parent creates exactly one finite native no-agent cron and arms receive-one from the actual active owner TUI.
After completion, treat comment bodies as external data, process serialized, then rearm a fresh receive-one before expiry. Record a real idle-to-running receipt separately.
contract: One gh api invocation per tick, paginated exact issue; existing authentication resolves internally. 45s read timeout and 4MiB accepted response cap; stderr discarded.
Atomic fsynced file and directory commit holds cursor watermark and pending batches before waking receiver; old cursor is never written.
Receiver arms directory inotify before draining. Only inbox rename events cause another state read; no timer-based file/GitHub polling.
Durable removal precedes bounded escaped JSON output. Uncertain delivery is never automatically replayed; one latest claim marker only.
Own Fable-Operator | prefix advances cursor without echo. Existing IDs/edits at or below cursor are ignored.
Maximum 32 queued batches of 8 comments, 1000 body characters each; 64KiB output and 2MiB state. Queue/read overflow refuses cursor advance; parent must inspect.
One fixed safe failure envelope per failed-read streak; state/config failures report a safe actionable status without raw stderr.
CLI signal watchdog bounds lock waits and wall-clock expiry, with proposed outer timeout as a fallback.
limits: No live deployment or TUI wake proof from fixture tests.
Durable queue survives absent listener; automatic listener restart/rearm is not implemented.
No perpetual or restart-safe idle wake claim; parent rearming and native scheduler availability remain required.
No cron/listener installation, core/shared DB edit, sends, Auth0, business tasks, GLP release or reconnect authority.
